title: Mini heatmap
description: Reference CODE component (architecture.md §7.6): a pure render({props, frame}) function executed in the capability-less QuickJS sandbox, mapping a series prop (a JSON array of numbers) onto a grid of intensity cells. Used by apps/renderer tests (code-component.test.ts) as the happy-path fixture. Deterministic by construction: no Date, no Math.random, no async — publish executes it twice and byte-compares the output.

accent.description: Cell color for non-zero values (intensity via opacity).

values.description: Numbers to plot, one cell each, wrapping into rows of 13. Bind with a sole path template (e.g. a connector timeseries) or pass a literal array. This default feeds publish validation and the palette preview.
